command description: Speed Class control command. Refer to Section 4.13.2.8.
Specify block count for CMD18 and CMD25.
In case of SDSC Card, block length is set by the SET_BLOCKLEN command¹. In case of SDHC and SDXC Cards, block length is fixed 512 Bytes regardless of the SET_BLOCKLEN command.
Continuously writes blocks of data until a STOP_TRANSMISSION follows. Block length is specified the same as WRITE_BLOCK command.
